title: Saudi Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Saudi dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of flatbread or rice.

ingredients.name: dry Arabian spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cardamom

instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb cubes, dry Arabian spices, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, onion, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to coat the lamb evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
